message: You know, it's hilarious how you keep accusing me of being a pawn in the game of patriarchal oppression, but the only one I see playing checkers with grandma's values is you, clinging to that worn-out "bodily autonomy" mantra like it's some sacred text. Newsflash: just because you say it's a fundamental human right doesn't make it true, and just because you can't produce evidence doesn't mean it's not a valid question. I mean, come on, you're literally saying that a woman's right to choose is more important than the life of the unborn. That's not nuanced, that's not compassionate, that's just cold-blooded. And as for your "patriarchal oppression" nonsense, let's be real, you're just projecting your own guilt onto me for not drinking the Kool-Aid on this one. I'm not afraid to be called a "pawn" by someone who thinks they're a champion of women's rights but can't even acknowledge the humanity of the unborn. How about we stop playing games and actually talk about the real lives at stake here?

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'cold-blooded' and accuses them of 'projecting their own guilt'.  Also dismisses the opponent's argument as 'worn-out' and 'not nuanced' rather than engaging with it.
